given: a confirmed booking for 5–8 October and a Staff Member holding front_desk.amend
when: they change it to 6–9 October and save
then: the booking holds 6–9 October, keeps its reference, Guest and price, and a revision records 5–8 → 6–9, who and when; the audit record reservation.amended says the same

given: a confirmed booking on room 101
when: they move it to room 104, also a room
then: it holds room 104 for the same nights at the same price, and a revision records 101 → 104

situation: Change the Unit to another kind
given: a booking on a room at 1500.00 and a suite priced at 3000.00
when: they move it to a suite
then: the dialog shows 1500.00 → 3000.00 before saving and the booking is stamped at today's suite price; a suite with no price makes it unpriced, said before saving. The quote guard applies: a price that changed while the dialog was open refuses the save (RT-S2-12)

given: a booking taken at 1500.00 when rooms now cost 1750.00
then: it keeps 1500.00: the price agreed with the Guest travels with the booking, and only a different kind of Unit is a different product (RT-DEF-03 resolved)

given: another confirmed booking holds room 104 on 7 October
when: a booking is moved onto room 104 for 6–9 October
then: refused by reservations_no_double_booking; the preview had already named the booking in the way (its reference), and the screen says those nights are booked

given: a Guest in house in room 104 until 8 October
when: a booking is moved onto room 104 from 6 October
then: refused with 55006 by app.unit_holds_one_occupancy (ADR 0033), which fires because the Unit or the dates moved; the screen says somebody is staying over those nights

given: the change dialog with new dates and a Unit
then: it shows whether those nights are free on that Unit and, if not, what holds them — a booking reference or a Guest in house — and what the booking will cost; it is read, never a promise, and the constraints still decide on save (blueprint 18.6)

situation: Units free for those nights first
given: a booking whose Unit is to change
then: Units of the same kind free for the chosen nights are listed first, then the others marked taken; out-of-service and blocked Units are not offered (blueprint 18.6 alternatives)

given: a Guest standing at the desk a day before their booking starts
when: the desk moves the arrival to today
then: allowed when the room is free tonight; the booking can then be checked in as usual (CI-DEF-01 resolved)

given: any booking
when: its arrival is set before the Property's today
then: refused, as taking a booking is (the period check and the module)

situation: A booking whose arrival has passed
given: a confirmed booking for yesterday; nobody came
then: allowed only to arrive today or later, which keeps a no-show from being rewritten onto a closed day (RZ001)

given: any booking
when: its departure is set on or before its arrival
then: refused: a booking covers at least one night; an open-ended booking stays allowed for a Resident only

given: a booking checked out, cancelled or marked a no-show
when: the desk tries to change it
then: refused: history is corrected by a reversal, never rewritten (blueprint 7.4); the action is not offered

given: a Guest already in house
then: not offered: an in-house Guest is extended, shortened or moved (s2, s3), which change the Stay and the booking together

given: room 104 out of order or blocked
when: a booking is moved onto it
then: refused as a booking onto it is; the picker does not offer it

situation: A room let by the bed
given: room 105 has beds under it
when: a booking is moved onto room 105
then: refused by the sellability trigger (ADR 0025); a bed under it can be chosen

situation: Moving a booking off a room out of order
given: a maintenance request takes room 101 out of order while bookings hold it
when: the desk follows the warning's link
then: each affected booking opens in Change booking with the free Units of its kind first (MT-DEF-07 resolved)

given: a priced booking and the Property's currency
then: cannot happen: a priced booking fixes the currency (RT-S2-07)

given: the same booking open on two screens
then: one wins; the second is refused as a booking that changed since it was read — the version it names no longer exists — and is shown the booking as it now stands

situation: Two moves between the same rooms
given: booking A moving from 101 to 104 and booking B from 104 to 101 at once
then: no deadlock: each takes both Unit locks in hashed order (ADR 0038's order), so one waits for the other; then the constraints decide

given: a Guest in house until 8 October
when: the desk extends them to 10 October
then: their Stay and booking end on 10 October; the extra nights are charged at the booking's own price as each night closes (RT-S3-01)

given: a confirmed booking on the same room from 9 October
then: refused with 55006 (ADR 0033): the room is promised from the 9th; the preview says to whom, and moving the Guest (s3) or the other booking (s1) is how the desk resolves it

given: a Guest in house until 10 October who will leave on the 8th
when: the desk sets the departure to 8 October
then: it ends on the 8th and the freed nights can be booked; an early departure on the day itself is a check-out, which already acknowledges it (CO-DIFF-05)

given: a Guest in house
when: the departure is set to today or earlier
then: refused: leaving today is a check-out, and a night already slept cannot be taken back

given: a Guest due out yesterday and still in the room
then: allowed from Close the day's checklist and from Departures: a departure from tomorrow on, so the day can close with them no longer overdue (CD-DEF-01 resolved)

given: a Resident in house with no departure
when: the desk sets one, or takes it away
then: allowed: an end of tomorrow or later; taking it away only for a Resident, since a Guest's booking has an end (RG-S1-11)

given: an extension or shortening after nights were charged
then: no charged night changes: only nights after today move, and a room night is never re-dated (RT-S3-09)

given: a checked-in booking
then: the booking's departure changes in the same transaction, so the two never disagree (app.stay_and_reservation_agree)

given: a Guest in house in room 101
when: the desk moves them to room 104 with a reason
then: their Stay continues in 104 from now: the same Stay, Folio and price; a revision records 101 → 104, the reason and who; room 101 becomes dirty through the worker (as a check-out makes it)

given: a move
then: a reason is required: the room has a fault, an upgrade, the Guest asked, or another with a note; it is the audit record's reason

situation: The new room must be ready
given: room 104 is dirty or in inspection
when: a Guest is moved into it
then: refused as a check-in into it would be (CI-S1-19), with the same words; a manager may not override in this slice

situation: The new room is occupied or booked
given: somebody is in room 104, or a booking holds it tonight
when: a Guest is moved into it
then: refused by the one-in-house index (ADR 0033) or the occupancy trigger, worded as at check-in

situation: A move to another kind of Unit
given: a Guest in a room at 1500.00 moved to a suite at 3000.00
then: the booked price is kept: a move is usually the hotel's decision; an upgrade the Guest pays for is posted as a Folio charge (built). The dialog says the price does not change

given: a Guest who slept two nights in 101 and moves today
then: the nights already spent stay against 101 in the history; room nights are charged per Stay, so nothing is re-posted or lost

given: a Guest in bed A of room 105
when: they move to bed B, or to a room
then: the same rules: a bed is a Unit (ADR 0025)

given: a Guest moved out of 101
then: stay.moved is published and the worker marks 101 dirty, exactly as for stay.checked_out, so the board and readiness follow

given: two desks move one Guest to different rooms
then: one move lands; the other is refused as a Stay that changed since it was read

given: the business day being worked is closed
when: a move or a departure change is saved
then: refused (RZ001) only if it would rewrite a closed day; a move takes effect from the working business date, which is open

situation: Who may change a booking or a stay
given: the shipped roles
then: Owner, Manager and Front Desk hold it; Finance and Housekeeping do not; one permission covers s1, s2 and s3

given: a Staff Member without front_desk.amend
then: refused by the update policies; the actions are not offered, and the booking is read-only for them

given: ranza_app
when: it updates a booking or a Stay
then: only dates and Unit, through column grants given to these commands, alongside the existing status grants; organization, Guest, stay type and price are never updated by a caller

given: any amendment, extension or move
then: one append-only reservation_changes row — kind, from and to dates, Units and price, the business date, the reason, who — readable on the booking's history and the audit log; never updated or deleted

situation: A lapsed Subscription or another Organization
given: a Staff Member outside the gates
then: refused by the five gates in the policies, as every front-desk write is (ADR 0012)

given: the change, extend and move dialogs
when: they are read in Turkish, English or Arabic
then: every word is translated, dates read in the Property's calendar, and the layout mirrors in Arabic

given: a booking or an in-house Guest
then: Reservations: Change booking on each open booking; Arrivals: Change for an early or late arrival; Departures and the room calendar's drawer: Extend, Shorten and Move for an in-house Guest; Close the day: Extend beside a Guest past departure

situation: Drag a bar on the room calendar
given: a bar dragged to another Unit or date
then: deferred (RC-DEF-05): the commands come first; dragging will call them with the same preview

situation: Split a stay across Units, or a group booking
given: a family in two rooms, or a Guest changing rooms on a known date ahead
then: deferred: one booking holds one Unit; a planned change of room ahead of time is two bookings until groups exist

situation: Move a booking to another Property
given: a Guest re-routed to a sister hotel
then: deferred: a Guest and prices are per Organization and Property; cancel and book at the other Property

given: a Guest who must move into a room still being cleaned
then: deferred: a move waits for a ready room, as a check-in does

given: a Guest who asks to pay a different nightly price mid-stay
then: deferred: nightly price overrides are rates' RT-DEF-02; a difference is posted as a Folio charge or reversal meanwhile
